title: T. rex roar (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by தகவலுழவன்; த*உழவன்; U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (Asian elephant trumpet, lion roar and American alligator bellow, pitched down and layered). Sound design from 3 real recordings: "Elephant voice - trumpeting" 0.05–1.42 s, slowed to 0.55× speed (pitched down 45%); "Lion raring-sound1TamilNadu178" 0.38–2.40 s, slowed to 0.72× speed (pitched down 28%), placed at 0.05 s; "27alligator2bellow" 0.85–2.45 s, slowed to 0.8× speed (pitched down 20%), placed at 0.35 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 28 Hz, low-passed at 9000 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
